title: ObjectForm (default layout): editing a record that does not exist opens a blank, editable form
body:
domain:ui#3 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jV4dWohojjbTJTQq5m

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding, class a, from #29247 (PR #29351; report comment 6577470165, `/mnt/project-files/issue-29247/os-dev-report.md`) · filed by `domain:ui#3` · ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

**Business reason.** A user who opens an edit link to a record that no longer exists, in the default object form, sees a blank form they can edit. They fill it in and press Update, and only then learn the record is gone. #29157 (PR #29246) fixed this for the modal form, and #29247 (PR #29351) for the drawer, tabbed and wizard forms. The default `object-form` layout is the one shell left.

**Measured (the #29247 os-dev, by a throwaway vitest probe, removed).** `ObjectForm` in edit mode with `findOne` answering `null` rendered an empty, enabled title input and the Update button, and no not-found state. Not reproduced at a public door (a Console route that mounts the default layout).

**Mechanism (read at `origin/main` `47718699`).** `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx:860` awaits `dataSource.findOne(...)` and passes the result straight to `snapshotLoadedRecord` and `setInitialData(data)` with no null check. `ObjectStackAdapter.readOne` answers `null` on a 404, so a missing record becomes an empty form.

**Wanted.** In edit mode, a null read fails the run with `RecordNotFoundError` and draws the same not-found state the other four shells draw (`Empty` with `empty.recordNotFound` / `empty.recordNotFoundDescription`; no form, no footer, no save). Reuse the module-private `RecordNotFoundError` and the `RecordNotFoundState` PR #29351 adds to `loadFailure.ts`. Create mode, a found record and a bus re-read of a found record are unchanged. No new string.

**Tests.** An edit whose `findOne` answers null renders the not-found state and no Update control; controls for create and a found record. Red on main.

**Landing site:** `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx`. Serialize after PR #29351 (#29247), which adds the shared drawing. Not the same defect as #29186 (Console FormPage's refused-read banner), which reads a 403 at a different site.

Dedupe: `is:issue ObjectForm edit missing record blank form` 10, `is:issue ObjectForm findOne null` 5 (only #29247, QA runs, sweeps and seat posts); `is:issue object-form record not found` 495 hits, scanned the open ones: #29186 is a different site and defect. No card covers the default ObjectForm.

Links back: #29247, PR #29351, #29157, PR #29246.
